G4400.root: middle voice from [[w:G4253]] and a derivative of [[w:G5495]]
G4400.strongs: to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose
senses: προ-χειρίζω (πρόχειρος, at hand)
to put into the hand, deliver up: pass., [[r:ACT.3.20|Act 3:20.]]

More frequently as depon., -ομαι, to take into one's hand; hence, metaphorically, to propose, determine, choose: with inf., [[r:ACT.22.14|Act 22:14]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.26.16|Act 26:16.]]† (AS)
προ-χειρο-τονέω, -ῶ (see χειροτονέω) to choose or appoint beforehand: [[r:ACT.10.41|Act 10:41]] (Plat., al.).† (AS)

G4402.strongs: before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian
senses: Prochorus: [[r:ACT.6.5|Act 6:5]] (AS)
prop. fem. of adj. πρύμνο, -η, -ον, (sc. ναῦς), the hindmost part of a ship, the stern: [[r:MRK.4.38|Mrk 4:38]], [[r:ACT.27.29|Act 27:29]]; opposite to πρῷρα, [[r:ACT.27.41|Act 27:41.]]† (AS)

G4404.strongs: at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch

G4405.root: feminine of a derivative of [[w:G4404]] as noun
senses: πρώιος (Rec. -ϊος), -α, -ον (πρωί), at early morn, early; as subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὥρα, cf. ἡ ὥ. ἡ π., [[r:3MA.5.24|3Ma 5:24]]), early morning: [[r:MAT.27.1|Mat 27:1]], [[r:JHN.21.4|Jhn 21:4]].† (AS)

G4406.strongs: dawning, i.e. (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season)
senses: πρόϊμος (Rec. πρώ-, of which προ- is a late form; see Bl., § 6, 4; WH, App., 152), -ον, = the more common πρώιος (which see), early: of rain (as most frequently in LXX), [[r:JAS.5.7|Jas 5:7.]]† (AS)

G4407.strongs: pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal
senses: πρωινός (Rec. -ϊνος, see WH, App., ή, -όν (πρωί), = cl. πρώιος, at early morn, early: ἀστήρ, [[r:REV.2.28|Rev 2:28 22:16]].† (AS)

G4408.forms: πρῷρα (Rec. incorrectly πρώρα, see Bl., § 3, 3; LS, see word), -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1; Mayser, l 2), ἡ

G4409.strongs: to be first (in rank or influence)
senses: (πρῶτος) to be first, pre-eminent, have the first place: [[r:COL.1.18|Col 1:18.]]† (AS)

G4410.strongs: a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council
senses: (πρῶιος, καθέδρα), the chief seat: [[r:MAT.23.6|Mat 23:6]], [[r:MRK.12.39|Mrk 12:39]] (see Swete, in l), [[r:LUK.11.43|Luk 11:43 20:46]].† (AS)

G4411.strongs: a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e. preeminence at meals
senses: πρωτο-κλυτία, -ας, ἡ the chief place at table (see Swete, Mk., l.with): [[r:MAT.23.6|Mat 23:6]], [[r:MRK.12.39|Mrk 12:39]], [[r:LUK.14.7|Luk 14:7-8 20:46]].† (AS)

senses: A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον, before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22.]] Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: [[r:JHN.7.50|Jhn 7:50]], [[r:2CO.1.15|2Co 1:15]], [[r:HEB.4.6|Heb 4:6]]; opposite to ἔπειτα, [[r:HEB.7.27|Heb 7:27]]; τὸ π., [[r:JHN.6.62|Jhn 6:62 9:8]], [[r:GAL.4.13|Gal 4:13]], [[r:1TI.1.13|1Ti 1:13]]; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, [[r:HEB.10.32|Heb 10:32]]; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, [[r:1PE.1.14|1Pe 1:14.]]† (AS)

as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, [[r:ACT.12.10|Act 12:10]]; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn 8:.20.4'>7] 20:4, 8 [[r:ACT.27.43|Act 27:43]], [[r:ROM.10.19|Rom 10:19]], [[r:1TI.1.16|1Ti 1:16]], [[r:1JN.4.19|1Jn 4:19]]; = πρότερος (see infr.; cf. Of Rank or Dignity, chief, principal: [[r:MAT.20.27|Mat 20:27 22:38]], [[r:MRK.9.35|Mrk 9:35]], [[r:EPH.6.2|Eph 6:2]], al.; with genitive, [[r:MRK.12.28|Mrk 12:28, 29]] al.; πόλις (Field, Notes, 124), [[r:ACT.16.12|Act 16:12]]; with art., [[r:LUK.15.22|Luk 15:22 19:47]], [[r:ACT.13.50|Act 13:50]], al.
Neut., πρῶτον, as adv., first, at the first;

(πρωτότοκος) the rights of the first-born, birthright (= cl. ἡ πρεσβεία): [[r:HEB.12.16|Heb 12:16.]]† (AS)

G4416.strongs: first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively)
senses: (πρῶτος, τίκτω) first-born: [[r:LUK.2.7|Luk 2:7]]; pl., [[r:HEB.11.28|Heb 11:28.]] Metaphorical, of the priority of Christ (originally perh. a Messianic title, cf. [[r:PSA.89.28|Psa 89:28]], [[r:HEB.1.6|Heb 1:6]]; see ICC on [[r:COL.1.15|Col 1:15]]): [[r:HEB.1.6|Heb 1:6]]; π. πάσης κτίσεως, [[r:COL.1.15|Col 1:15]]; ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς, [[r:ROM.8.29|Rom 8:29]]; π. senses: πταίω
trans., to cause to stumble ([[r:1SA.4.3|1Ki 4:3]], cf. Deiss., BS, 681).
Intrans., to stumble. Metaphorical, in moral sense, [[r:ROM.11.11|Rom 11:11]], [[r:JAS.2.10|Jas 2:10 3:2]], [[r:2PE.1.10|2Pe 1:10]].† (AS)
the heel: figuratively, ἐπαίρειν τὴν π. ἐπί, [[r:JHN.13.18|Jhn 13:18]] (LXX).† (AS)

G4420.root: from a derivative of [[w:G4072]] (meaning a feather)

(πέτομαι), winged; as subst., π., birds: [[r:1CO.15.39|1Co 15:39.]]† (AS)

a winnowing shovel or fan: [[r:MAT.3.12|Mat 3:12]], [[r:LUK.3.17|Luk 3:17]].† (AS)

(πτύω) spittle: [[r:JHN.9.6|Jhn 9:6]] (Hipp., Polyb., al.).† (AS)

of living creatures, in cl. (poët. only) usually with genitive, νεκρῶν, etc., but also absol., as in late writers and NT, a fallen body, a carcase, corpse: [[r:MAT.14.12|Mat 14:12 24:28]], [[r:MRK.15.45|Mrk 15:45]]; π. αὐτοῦ, [[r:MRK.6.29|Mrk 6:29]]; αὐτῶν, [[r:REV.11.8|Rev 11:8-9]] (cf. Rutherford, NPhr., 472 f.).† (AS)

G4434.strongs: akin to and the alternate of); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed)

In Plut. (ii, 414 E), a name given to ventriloquist soothsayers (ἐγγαστρίμυθοι; cf. [[r:LEV.19.31|Lev 19:31 20:6, 27]], [[r:1SA.28.7|1Ki 28:7]]), and perhaps in this sense πνεῦμα πύθωνα, a python-spirit: [[r:ACT.16.16|Act 16:16.]]† (AS)

G4439.strongs: a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively)

to learn by inquiry: before ὅτι, [[r:ACT.23.34|Act 23:34.]]† (AS)

a tower: [[r:LUK.13.4|Luk 13:4]]; of a watch-tower in a vineyard ([[r:ISA.5.2|Isa 5:2]]): [[r:MAT.21.33|Mat 21:33]], [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1]], and prob., [[r:LUK.14.28|Luk 14:28.]]† (AS)

Of metals (cf. [[r:JOB.22.25|Job 22:25]], [[r:PSA.12.7|Psa 12:7]], [[r:ZEC.13.9|Zec 13:9]]), to be refined or purified by fire: [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18]] (and so in RV, [[r:REV.1.15|Rev 1:15]], but see supr.).† (AS)

a burning: [[r:REV.18.9|Rev 18:9, 18]].
a refining or trial by fire: metaphorically, [[r:1PE.4.12|1Pe 4:12.]]† (AS)

G4453.strongs: to barter (as a pedlar), i.e. to sell
senses: to exchange or barter.

senses: (in cl. also) a foal, colt, prop., of a horse, then the young of other animals; in NT of the colt of an ass: [[r:MAT.21.2|Mat 21:2]], 5" (LXX), [[r:MAT.21.7|Mat 21:7]], [[r:MRK.11.2|Mrk 11:2, 4-5 11:7]], [[r:LUK.19.30|Luk 19:30, 33 19:35]], [[r:JHN.12.15|Jhn 12:15]]" (LXX).† (AS)

As sometimes in cl. but more frequently and increasingly so in late writers (see WM, §57, 2; Bl., §70, 2; Thumb, MGr., 192; Jannaris, Gr., App., vi, 13f.), = ὅπως, ὥς;

(and Ραχάβ, [[r:MAT.1.5|Mat 1:5]]; Ραχάβη, -ης, in FlJ), ἡ, indecl. (Heb. רָחָב) Rahab (LXX, [[r:JOS.2.1|Jos 2:1]], al.): [[r:HEB.11.31|Heb 11:31]], [[r:JAS.2.25|Jas 2:25]].† (AS)

ῥαββουνεί (Rec. -βονί, see: ῥαββεί) (Aram. רַבּוֺנִי, later, רִבּוֺנִי my master; on the Greek vocalization and the relation of the word to ῥαββεί, see Dalman, Words, 324, 340; Gr., 140; DB, iv, 190) Rabboni: [[r:MRK.10.51|Mrk 10:51]] (WH, mg., κύριε ῥαββεί), [[r:JHN.20.16|Jhn 20:16.]]† (AS)

a staff, such as is used on a journey: [[r:MAT.10.10|Mat 10:10]], [[r:MRK.6.8|Mrk 6:8]], [[r:LUK.9.3|Luk 9:3]], [[r:HEB.11.21|Heb 11:21]]" (LXX);
a ruler's staff, a sceptre: [[r:HEB.1.8|Heb 1:8]] (LXX) [[r:REV.2.27|Rev 2:27 12:5 19:15]]; (with) a rod for chastisement (cf. ῥαβδίζω): ἐν ῥ. (see: ἐν): [[r:1CO.4.21|1Co 4:21.]]† (AS)

= ῥήσσω (Dem., al.), to throw or dash down: [[r:MRK.9.18|Mrk 9:18]], [[r:LUK.9.42|Luk 9:42]] (cf. δια-, περι-, προσ-ρήγνυμι).† SYN.: θραύω, κατάγνυμι (AS)

ῥίπτω and ([[r:ACT.22.23|Act 22:23]]) ῥιπτέω (strengthened form; see Veitch, see word ῥίπτω, fin.),

to throw, cast, hurl: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.27.5|Mat 27:5]], [[r:ACT.27.19|Act 27:19, 29]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.15.30|Mat 15:30]], [[r:LUK.4.35|Luk 4:35]]; pass., [[r:LUK.17.2|Luk 17:2]]; ptcp., ἐριμμένοι, cast down, prostrate (Polyb., al.): [[r:MAT.9.36|Mat 9:36]]; of garments, to throw off (for flight, Eur., Xen., al.; ὅπλα, [[r:1MA.5.43|1Ma 5:43]]; so EV in [[r:ACT.22.23|Act 22:23]], but see infr.).

= ῥιπτάζω, to shake, toss, throw about: τ. ἱμάτια, [[r:ACT.22.23|Act 22:23]] (EGT, Page, Rackham, in l; Field, Notes, 136; but see supr.).† (AS)

as conjc., lest haply: in final sentences, [[r:1CO.9.27|1Co 9:27]], [[r:2CO.2.7|2Co 2:7 9:4]]; after verbs of fearing or taking heed, [[r:1CO.8.9|1Co 8:9]], [[r:2CO.11.3|2Co 11:3 12:20]], [[r:GAL.4.11|Gal 4:11]]; with an ellipse of ptcp.
